titles_native.title: 我につけ！ アニマル学園

description:
A sick gag love story unfolds between the main character Han Bom and the harps assigned to the troubled avant-garde! A long-awaited school life with Han Bom, a tamer who is cuter than the harps, and a variety of really cute harps!
